~~~~cshtml
        </div>


        <div class="col-md-4">

            <div class="card shadow-sm h-100">

                <div class="card-body">

                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between">

                        <div>

                            <div class="text-muted small">
                                Maximum Permissions
                            </div>

                            <h3 class="mb-0">
                                @(
                                    rolePermissionCounts.Values
                                        .DefaultIfEmpty()
                                        .Max()
                                )
                            </h3>

                            <small class="text-muted">
                                Maximum assigned to one role
                            </small>

                        </div>

                        <div class="text-warning fs-2">
                            <i class="bi bi-key"></i>
                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Roles Table -->

    <div class="card shadow-sm">

        <div class="card-header bg-white">

            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">

                <div>

                    <h5 class="mb-0">
                        System Roles
                    </h5>

                    <small class="text-muted">
                        Roles control what users can access and perform.
                    </small>

                </div>

                <span class="badge bg-secondary">
                    @Model.Count roles
                </span>

            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="card-body p-0">

            @if (Model.Any())
            {
                <div class="table-responsive">

                    <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">

                        <thead class="table-light">

                            <tr>

                                <th>
                                    Role
                                </th>

                                <th class="text-center">
                                    Users
                                </th>

                                <th class="text-center">
                                    Permissions
                                </th>

                                <th>
                                    Status
                                </th>

                                <th class="text-end"
                                    style="width: 300px;">

                                    Actions

                                </th>

                            </tr>

                        </thead>


                        <tbody>

                            @foreach (var role in Model)
                            {
                                var usersCount =
                                    roleUsers.TryGetValue(
                                        role.Id,
                                        out var users)
                                        ? users
                                        : 0;

                                var permissionsCount =
                                    rolePermissionCounts.TryGetValue(
                                        role.Id,
                                        out var permissions)
                                        ? permissions
                                        : 0;

                                var isAdmin =
                                    string.Equals(
                                        role.Name,
                                        "Admin",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                                <tr>

                                    <!-- Role -->

                                    <td>

                                        <div class="fw-semibold">
                                            @role.Name
                                        </div>

                                        <small class="text-muted">
                                            Role ID:
                                            @role.Id
                                        </small>

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Users -->

                                    <td class="text-center">

                                        <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border">

                                            <i class="bi bi-people"></i>

                                            @usersCount

                                        </span>

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Permissions -->

                                    <td class="text-center">

                                        <span class="badge bg-light text-dark border">

                                            <i class="bi bi-key"></i>

                                            @permissionsCount

                                        </span>

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Status -->

                                    <td>

                                        @if (isAdmin)
                                        {
                                            <span class="badge bg-danger">
                                                System Role
                                            </span>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <span class="badge bg-success">
                                                Custom Role
                                            </span>
                                        }

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Actions -->

                                    <td class="text-end">

                                        <div class="d-inline-flex align-items-center gap-2">

                                            @if (canEdit && !isAdmin)
                                            {
                                                <a asp-action="Edit"
                                                   asp-route-id="@role.Id"
                                                   class="btn btn-sm btn-warning">

                                                    <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
                                                    Edit

                                                </a>
                                            }

                                            @if (isAdmin)
                                            {
                                                <button type="button"
                                                        class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"
                                                        disabled
                                                        title="System role cannot be deleted.">

                                                    <i class="bi bi-shield-lock"></i>
                                                    Protected

                                                </button>
                                            }
                                            else if (usersCount > 0)
                                            {
                                                <button type="button"
                                                        class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"
                                                        disabled
                                                        title="This role cannot be deleted because it is assigned to users.">

                                                    <i class="bi bi-lock"></i>
                                                    In Use

                                                </button>
                                            }
                                            else if (canDelete)
                                            {
                                                <a asp-action="Delete"
                                                   asp-route-id="@role.Id"
                                                   class="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
                                                   onclick="return confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this role?');">

                                                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                                                    Delete

                                                </a>
                                            }

                                        </div>

                                    </td>

                                </tr>
                            }

                        </tbody>

                    </table>

                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <div class="text-center p-5">

                    <div class="fs-1 text-muted mb-3">
                        <i class="bi bi-shield-lock"></i>
                    </div>

                    <h5>
                        No roles found
                    </h5>

                    <p class="text-muted">
                        Create your first role to start
                        managing user permissions.
                    </p>

                    @if (canCreate)
                    {
                        <a asp-action="Create"
                           class="btn btn-primary">

                            <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i>
                            Create Role

                        </a>
                    }

                </div>
            }

        </div>

    </div>
    ```

</div>
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
@using System.Globalization
@using System.Text.Json
@model MiniStore.Application.DTOs.Sales.CreateSaleDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Create Sale";
}

<div class="container mt-4">

    <h2>Create Sale</h2>

    <hr />

    <form asp-action="Create" method="post">

        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

        <input type="hidden" name="channel" value="Wholesale" />

        <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly"
             class="text-danger mb-3">
        </div>

        <!-- Sale Information -->

        <div class="row">

            <div class="col-md-4">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label asp-for="Date"
                           class="form-label">
                        Date
                    </label>

                    <input asp-for="Date"
                           type="date"
                           class="form-control" />

                    <span asp-validation-for="Date"
                          class="text-danger">
                    </span>

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="col-md-4">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label asp-for="WarehouseId"
                           class="form-label">
                        Warehouse
                    </label>

                    <select asp-for="WarehouseId"
                            class="form-select">

                        <option value="">
                            -- Select Warehouse --
                        </option>

                        @foreach (var warehouse in ViewBag.Warehouses)
                        {
                            <option value="@warehouse.Id">
                                @warehouse.Name
                            </option>
                        }

                    </select>

                    <span asp-validation-for="WarehouseId"
                          class="text-danger">
                    </span>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

        <div class="mb-3">

            <label asp-for="Notes"
                   class="form-label">
                Notes
            </label>

            <textarea asp-for="Notes"
                      class="form-control">
            </textarea>

        </div>

        <hr />

        <!-- Add Item -->

        <h4>Sale Items</h4>

        <div class="row align-items-end">

            <div class="col-md-4">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        Product
                    </label>

                    <input id="productSearch"
                           class="form-control mb-2"
                           placeholder="Search by product name or barcode"
                           autocomplete="off" />

                    <select id="productId"
                            class="form-select">

                        <option value="">
                            -- Select Product --
                        </option>

                        @foreach (var product in ViewBag.Products)
                        {
                            <option value="@product.Id"
                                    data-sale-price="@product.SalePrice.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)"
                                    data-barcode="@product.Barcode">

                                @product.Name (@product.Barcode)

                            </option>
                        }

                    </select>

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="col-md-2">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        Quantity
                    </label>

                    <input id="quantity"
                           type="number"
                           step="0.001"
                           min="0.001"
                           value="1"
                           class="form-control" />

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="col-md-2">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        Sale Price
                    </label>

                    <input id="salePrice"
                           type="number"
                           step="0.01"
                           min="0"
                           class="form-control"
                           readonly />

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="col-md-2">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        Discount Type
                    </label>

                    <select id="discountType"
                            class="form-select">

                        <option value="1">
                            Percentage
                        </option>

                        <option value="2">
                            Fixed Amount
                        </option>

                    </select>

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="col-md-2">

                <div class="mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        Discount
                    </label>

                    <input id="discountValue"
                           type="number"
                           step="0.01"
                           min="0"
                           value="0"
                           class="form-control" />

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

        <div class="row">

            <div class="col-md-3">

                <button type="button"
                        id="addItem"
                        class="btn btn-success w-100 mb-3">

                    Add Item

                </button>

            </div>

        </div>

        <!-- Items Table -->

        <div class="table-responsive">

            <table class="table table-bordered table-striped">

                <thead>

                    <tr>

                        <th>Product</th>
                        <th>Quantity</th>
                        <th>Sale Price</th>
                        <th>Gross Total</th>
                        <th>Discount</th>
                        <th>Discount Amount</th>
                        <th>Total</th>
                        <th></th>

                    </tr>

                </thead>

                <tbody id="itemsTableBody">
                </tbody>

            </table>

        </div>

        <hr />

        <!-- Invoice Discount -->

        <div class="row justify-content-end">

            <div class="col-md-5">

                <div class="card">

                    <div class="card-body">

                        <h5 class="card-title">
                            Invoice Discount
                        </h5>

                        <div class="mb-3">

                            <label asp-for="InvoiceDiscountType"
                                   class="form-label">

                                Discount Type

                            </label>

                            <select asp-for="InvoiceDiscountType"
                                    id="invoiceDiscountType"
                                    class="form-select">

                                <option value="1">
                                    Percentage
                                </option>

                                <option value="2">
                                    Fixed Amount
                                </option>

                            </select>

                        </div>

                        <div class="mb-3">

                            <label asp-for="InvoiceDiscountValue"
                                   class="form-label">

                                Discount

                            </label>

                            <input asp-for="InvoiceDiscountValue"
                                   id="invoiceDiscountValue"
                                   type="number"
                                   step="0.01"
                                   min="0"
                                   class="form-control" />

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

        <br />

        <!-- Totals -->

        <div class="row justify-content-end">

            <div class="col-md-5">

                <table class="table table-bordered">

                    <tbody>

                        <tr>

                            <th>
                                Subtotal
                            </th>

                            <td id="subtotal"
                                class="text-end">

                                0.00

                            </td>

                        </tr>

                        <tr>

                            <th>
                                Invoice Discount
                            </th>

                            <td id="invoiceDiscountAmount"
                                class="text-end">

                                0.00

                            </td>

                        </tr>

                        <tr>

                            <th>
                                <strong>Grand Total</strong>
                            </th>

                            <td class="text-end">

                                <strong id="grandTotal">
                                    0.00
                                </strong>

                            </td>

                        </tr>

                    </tbody>

                </table>

            </div>

        </div>

        <button type="submit"
                class="btn btn-primary">

            Save Sale

        </button>

        <a asp-action="Index"
           class="btn btn-secondary">

            Cancel

        </a>

    </form>

</div>


@section Scripts {

    <script>

        let itemIndex = 0;

        const addItemButton =
            document.getElementById("addItem");

        const itemsTableBody =
            document.getElementById("itemsTableBody");

        const productSearch =
            document.getElementById("productSearch");

        const productSelect =
            document.getElementById("productId");

        const salePriceInput =
            document.getElementById("salePrice");

        const quantityInput =
            document.getElementById("quantity");

        const discountTypeSelect =
            document.getElementById("discountType");

        const discountValueInput =
            document.getElementById("discountValue");

        const invoiceDiscountType =
            document.getElementById("invoiceDiscountType");

        const invoiceDiscountValue =
            document.getElementById("invoiceDiscountValue");

        const subtotalElement =
            document.getElementById("subtotal");

        const invoiceDiscountAmountElement =
            document.getElementById("invoiceDiscountAmount");

        const grandTotalElement =
            document.getElementById("grandTotal");


        /*
         * Existing items returned from the server.
         *
         * This is important when the POST fails because of
         * insufficient stock or another business validation error.
         *
         * The server returns the original CreateSaleDto,
         * including Items, so we rebuild the table here.
         */

        const existingItems =
            @Html.Raw(JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.Items));


        productSelect.addEventListener(
            "change",
            updateSalePrice
        );


        productSearch.addEventListener(
            "input",
            filterProducts
        );


        productSearch.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {

                if (event.key !== "Enter") {
                    return;
                }

                event.preventDefault();

                const barcode =
                    productSearch.value
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase();

                const product =
                    [...productSelect.options]
                        .find(option =>
                            option.dataset.barcode?.toLowerCase()
                            === barcode);

                if (product) {

                    productSelect.value =
                        product.value;

                    updateSalePrice();

                }

            }
        );


        invoiceDiscountType.addEventListener(
            "change",
            calculateTotals
        );


        invoiceDiscountValue.addEventListener(
            "input",
            calculateTotals
        );


        /*
         * Add a new item from the product selector.
         */

        addItemButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                const productId =
                    productSelect.value;

                if (!productId) {

                    alert("Product is required.");

                    return;
                }


                const selectedProduct =
                    productSelect.selectedOptions[0];

                const productName =
                    selectedProduct.text;


                const quantity =
                    parseFloat(
                        quantityInput.value
                    );


                const salePrice =
                    parseFloat(
                        salePriceInput.value
                    );


                const discountType =
                    parseInt(
                        discountTypeSelect.value
                    );


                const discountValue =
                    parseFloat(
                        discountValueInput.value
                    ) || 0;


                if (!quantity || quantity <= 0) {

                    alert(
                        "Quantity must be greater than zero."
                    );

                    return;
                }


                if (
                    isNaN(salePrice) ||
                    salePrice < 0
                ) {

                    alert(
                        "Sale price is invalid."
                    );

                    return;
                }


                if (discountValue < 0) {

                    alert(
                        "Discount cannot be negative."
                    );

                    return;
                }


                const grossTotal =
                    quantity * salePrice;


                let discountAmount = 0;


                if (discountType === 1) {

                    if (discountValue > 100) {

                        alert(
                            "Percentage discount cannot exceed 100%."
                        );

                        return;
                    }

                    discountAmount =
                        grossTotal *
                        discountValue /
                        100;

                }
                else if (discountType === 2) {

                    discountAmount =
                        discountValue;

                }


                if (discountAmount > grossTotal) {
                    discountAmount = grossTotal;
                }


                const total =
                    grossTotal -
                    discountAmount;


                addItemRow(
                    productId,
                    productName,
                    quantity,
                    salePrice,
                    discountType,
                    discountValue,
                    discountAmount,
                    grossTotal,
                    total
                );


                productSelect.value = "";

                productSearch.value = "";

                quantityInput.value = "1";

                salePriceInput.value = "";

                discountTypeSelect.value = "1";

                discountValueInput.value = "0";

            }
        );


        /*
         * Remove item.
         */

        itemsTableBody.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function (event) {

                if (
                    event.target.classList.contains(
                        "remove-item"
                    )
                ) {

                    event.target
                        .closest("tr")
                        .remove();

                    calculateTotals();

                }

            }
        );


        /*
         * Add item row to the table.
         *
         * This function is used both when the user adds
         * a new item and when the server returns the
         * previously entered items after validation failure.
         */

        function addItemRow(
            productId,
            productName,
            quantity,
            salePrice,
            discountType,
            discountValue,
            discountAmount,
            grossTotal,
            total
        ) {

            const row =
                document.createElement("tr");


            const discountText =
                discountType === 1
                    ? `${discountValue.toFixed(2)}%`
                    : discountValue.toFixed(2);


            row.innerHTML = `

                <td>

                    ${escapeHtml(productName)}

                    <input type="hidden"
                           name="Items[${itemIndex}].ProductId"
                           value="${productId}" />

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${quantity.toFixed(3)}

                    <input type="hidden"
                           name="Items[${itemIndex}].Quantity"
                           value="${quantity}" />

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${salePrice.toFixed(2)}

                    <input type="hidden"
                           name="Items[${itemIndex}].SalePrice"
                           value="${salePrice}" />

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${grossTotal.toFixed(2)}

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${discountText}

                    <input type="hidden"
                           name="Items[${itemIndex}].DiscountType"
                           value="${discountType}" />

                    <input type="hidden"
                           name="Items[${itemIndex}].DiscountValue"
                           value="${discountValue}" />

                </td>


                <td>

                    ${discountAmount.toFixed(2)}

                </td>


                <td class="line-total">

                    ${total.toFixed(2)}

                </td>


                <td>

                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn btn-danger btn-sm remove-item">

                        Remove

                    </button>

                </td>

            `;


            itemsTableBody.appendChild(row);

            itemIndex++;

            calculateTotals();

        }


        /*
         * Rebuild items that came back from the server.
         *
         * On the first normal GET:
         *
         * Model.Items = []
         *
         * Nothing happens.
         *
         * On a failed POST:
         *
         * Model.Items contains the user's original items,
         * so they are restored into the table.
         */

        if (
            Array.isArray(existingItems) &&
            existingItems.length > 0
        ) {

            existingItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const productOption =
                    [...productSelect.options]
                        .find(option =>
                            option.value ==
                            item.ProductId
                        );


                let productName =
                    `Product #${item.ProductId}`;


                if (productOption) {

                    productName =
                        productOption.text;

                }


                const quantity =
                    Number(item.Quantity) || 0;


                const salePrice =
                    Number(item.SalePrice) || 0;


                const discountType =
                    Number(item.DiscountType) || 1;


                const discountValue =
                    Number(item.DiscountValue) || 0;


                const grossTotal =
                    quantity * salePrice;


                let discountAmount = 0;


                if (discountType === 1) {

                    discountAmount =
                        grossTotal *
                        discountValue /
                        100;

                }
                else if (discountType === 2) {

                    discountAmount =
                        discountValue;

                }


                if (discountAmount > grossTotal) {
                    discountAmount = grossTotal;
                }


                const total =
                    grossTotal -
                    discountAmount;


                addItemRow(
                    item.ProductId,
                    productName,
                    quantity,
                    salePrice,
                    discountType,
                    discountValue,
                    discountAmount,
                    grossTotal,
                    total
                );

            });

        }


        /*
         * Calculate invoice totals.
         */

        function calculateTotals() {

            let subtotal = 0;


            const rows =
                itemsTableBody.querySelectorAll("tr");


            rows.forEach(row => {

                const totalCell =
                    row.querySelector(".line-total");


                if (totalCell) {

                    subtotal +=
                        parseFloat(
                            totalCell.innerText
                        ) || 0;

                }

            });


            const discountType =
                parseInt(
                    invoiceDiscountType.value
                );


            const discountValue =
                parseFloat(
                    invoiceDiscountValue.value
                ) || 0;


            let invoiceDiscount = 0;


            if (discountValue > 0) {

                if (discountType === 1) {

                    invoiceDiscount =
                        subtotal *
                        discountValue /
                        100;

                }
                else if (discountType === 2) {

                    invoiceDiscount =
                        discountValue;

                }

            }


            if (invoiceDiscount > subtotal) {
                invoiceDiscount = subtotal;
            }


            const grandTotal =
                subtotal -
                invoiceDiscount;


            subtotalElement.innerText =
                subtotal.toFixed(2);


            invoiceDiscountAmountElement.innerText =
                invoiceDiscount.toFixed(2);


            grandTotalElement.innerText =
                grandTotal.toFixed(2);

        }


        /*
         * Escape product names before inserting them
         * into the HTML table.
         */

        function escapeHtml(value) {

            const element =
                document.createElement("div");

            element.textContent =
                value;

            return element.innerHTML;

        }


        /*
         * Update sale price when product changes.
         */

        function updateSalePrice() {

            const selectedProduct =
                productSelect.selectedOptions[0];


            salePriceInput.value =
                selectedProduct?.dataset.salePrice
                ?? "";

        }


        /*
         * Filter products by name or barcode.
         */

        function filterProducts() {

            const query =
                productSearch.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();


            [...productSelect.options]
                .forEach(option => {

                    if (!option.value) {

                        option.hidden = false;

                        return;
                    }


                    option.hidden =
                        !option.text
                            .toLowerCase()
                            .includes(query);

                });

        }

    </script>

}
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
```cshtml
@using MiniStore.Domain.Enums
@model MiniStore.Application.DTOs.Sales.SaleDetailsDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Sale Details";
}

<div class="container mt-4">

    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">

        <h2>Sale Details</h2>

        <a asp-action="Index"
           class="btn btn-secondary">
            Back
        </a>

    </div>


    <!-- Sale Information -->

    <div class="card mb-4">

        <div class="card-body">

            <div class="row">

                <div class="col-md-4">

                    <strong>Invoice Number:</strong>

                    <div>
                        @Model.InvoiceNumber
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="col-md-4">

                    <strong>Date:</strong>

                    <div>
                        @Model.Date.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="col-md-4">

                    <strong>Warehouse:</strong>

                    <div>
                        @Model.WarehouseId
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>


            @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Notes))
            {
                <hr />

                <strong>Notes:</strong>

                <p>
                    @Model.Notes
                </p>
            }

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Items -->

    <h4>Items</h4>

    <div class="table-responsive">

        <table class="table table-bordered table-striped">

            <thead>

                <tr>

                    <th>Product</th>

                    <th>Quantity</th>

                    <th>Sale Price</th>

                    <th>Gross Total</th>

                    <th>Discount</th>

                    <th>Discount Amount</th>

                    <th>Total</th>

                </tr>

            </thead>


            <tbody>

                @foreach (var item in Model.Items)
                {
                    <tr>

                        <td>
                            @item.ProductId
                        </td>


                        <td>
                            @item.Quantity
                        </td>


                        <td>
                            @item.SalePrice.ToString("0.00")
                        </td>


                        <td>
                            @item.GrossTotal.ToString("0.00")
                        </td>


                        <td>

                            @if (item.DiscountValue > 0)
                            {
                                if (item.DiscountType == DiscountType.Percentage)
                                {
                                    @($"{item.DiscountValue:0.##}%")
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    @item.DiscountValue.ToString("0.00")
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                @:-
                            }

                        </td>


                        <td>
                            @item.DiscountAmount.ToString("0.00")
                        </td>


                        <td>
                            @item.Total.ToString("0.00")
                        </td>

                    </tr>
                }

            </tbody>

        </table>

    </div>


    <!-- Invoice Totals -->

    <div class="row justify-content-end">

        <div class="col-md-5">

            <table class="table table-bordered">

                <tbody>

                    <tr>

                        <th>
                            Subtotal
                        </th>

                        <td class="text-end">

                            @Model.Subtotal.ToString("0.00")

                        </td>

                    </tr>


                    <tr>

                        <th>
                            Invoice Discount
                        </th>

                        <td class="text-end">

                            @if (Model.InvoiceDiscountValue > 0)
                            {
                                if (Model.InvoiceDiscountType == DiscountType.Percentage)
                                {
                                    <div>
                                        @($"{Model.InvoiceDiscountValue:0.##}%")
                                    </div>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <div>
                                        @Model.InvoiceDiscountValue.ToString("0.00")
                                    </div>
                                }

                                <small class="text-muted">
                                    Discount Amount:
                                    @Model.InvoiceDiscountAmount.ToString("0.00")
                                </small>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                @:-
                            }

                        </td>

                    </tr>


                    <tr>

                        <th>
                            <strong>Grand Total</strong>
                        </th>

                        <td class="text-end">

                            <strong>
                                @Model.TotalAmount.ToString("0.00")
                            </strong>

                        </td>

                    </tr>

                </tbody>

            </table>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
<!--
    Razor generates the stock data here as JSON-like data.

    Keeping it outside the JavaScript code prevents Visual Studio
    from trying to interpret Razor's @foreach as JavaScript.
-->
<script type="application/json" id="stockData">
[
    @foreach (var stock in ViewBag.ProductStocks)
    {
        <text>
        {
            "productId": @stock.ProductId,
            "warehouseId": @stock.WarehouseId,
            "quantity": @stock.Quantity.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
        },
        </text>
    }
]
</script>


@section Scripts {

    <script>

        const cart = new Map();


        // Read stock data generated by Razor.
        const stockData = JSON.parse(
            document.getElementById("stockData").textContent
        );


        // Convert stock data into a fast lookup Map.
        const stockByProductWarehouse = new Map(
            stockData.map(stock => [
                `${stock.productId}-${stock.warehouseId}`,
                stock.quantity
            ])
        );


        const warehouseInput =
            document.getElementById("warehouseId");

        const productSearch =
            document.getElementById("productSearch");

        const productButtons =
            [...document.querySelectorAll(".product-button")];

        const cartItems =
            document.getElementById("cartItems");


        // Warehouse changed.
        warehouseInput.addEventListener(
            "change",
            updateProductAvailability
        );


        // Product search.
        productSearch.addEventListener(
            "input",
            filterProducts
        );


        // Barcode Enter.
        productSearch.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            event => {

                if (event.key !== "Enter")
                    return;

                event.preventDefault();

                const barcode =
                    productSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();

                const product =
                    productButtons.find(
                        button =>
                            button.dataset.barcode.toLowerCase() === barcode
                    );

                if (product && !product.disabled) {

                    addProduct(product);

                    productSearch.value = "";

                    filterProducts();
                }

            }
        );


        // Product buttons.
        productButtons.forEach(
            button =>
                button.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    () => addProduct(button)
                )
        );


        // Clear cart.
        document
            .getElementById("clearCart")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                () => {

                    cart.clear();

                    renderCart();

                }
            );


        // Submit validation.
        document
            .getElementById("posForm")
            .addEventListener(
                "submit",
                event => {

                    if (!warehouseInput.value || cart.size === 0) {

                        event.preventDefault();

                        document
                            .getElementById("validationSummary")
                            .textContent =
                            !warehouseInput.value
                                ? "Please select a warehouse before completing the sale."
                                : "Add at least one product to the cart.";

                    }

                }
            );


        function getAvailableStock(productId) {

            if (!warehouseInput.value)
                return null;

            return stockByProductWarehouse.get(
                `${productId}-${warehouseInput.value}`
            ) ?? 0;

        }


        function updateProductAvailability() {

            productButtons.forEach(
                button => {

                    const available =
                        getAvailableStock(button.dataset.id);

                    const label =
                        button.querySelector(".product-stock");


                    if (available === null) {

                        button.disabled = false;

                        label.textContent =
                            "Select a warehouse";

                        return;
                    }


                    button.disabled =
                        available <= 0;


                    label.textContent =
                        available > 0
                            ? `Available: ${available}`
                            : "Out of stock";


                    label.className =
                        `badge stock-badge mt-2 ${
                            available > 0
                                ? "text-bg-success"
                                : "text-bg-danger"
                        }`;

                }
            );


            cart.clear();

            renderCart();

        }


        function filterProducts() {

            const query =
                productSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();

            let visibleCount = 0;


            document
                .querySelectorAll(".product-wrapper")
                .forEach(
                    wrapper => {

                        const visible =
                            wrapper.dataset.search
                                .toLowerCase()
                                .includes(query);


                        wrapper.classList.toggle(
                            "d-none",
                            !visible
                        );


                        if (visible)
                            visibleCount++;

                    }
                );


            document
                .getElementById("noProducts")
                .classList.toggle(
                    "d-none",
                    visibleCount !== 0
                );

        }


        function addProduct(button) {

            if (!warehouseInput.value) {

                document
                    .getElementById("validationSummary")
                    .textContent =
                    "Please select a warehouse first.";

                warehouseInput.focus();

                return;
            }


            const id =
                button.dataset.id;


            const available =
                getAvailableStock(id);


            const current =
                cart.get(id);


            const nextQuantity =
                (current?.quantity ?? 0) + 1;


            if (nextQuantity > available) {

                document
                    .getElementById("validationSummary")
                    .textContent =
                    "The requested quantity exceeds available stock.";

                return;
            }


            cart.set(
                id,
                {
                    id,
                    name: button.dataset.name,
                    price: Number(button.dataset.price),
                    quantity: nextQuantity
                }
            );


            document
                .getElementById("validationSummary")
                .textContent = "";


            renderCart();

        }


        function changeQuantity(id, change) {

            const item =
                cart.get(id);


            const nextQuantity =
                item.quantity + change;


            if (nextQuantity <= 0) {

                cart.delete(id);

            }
            else if (
                nextQuantity <= getAvailableStock(id)
            ) {

                item.quantity =
                    nextQuantity;

            }


            renderCart();

        }


        function renderCart() {

            cartItems.innerHTML = "";

            let totalQuantity = 0;

            let grandTotal = 0;


            if (cart.size === 0) {

                cartItems.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="cart-empty">Your cart is empty.<br />Choose products to begin.</div>';

            }


            [...cart.values()].forEach(
                (item, index) => {

                    const total =
                        item.price * item.quantity;


                    totalQuantity +=
                        item.quantity;


                    grandTotal +=
                        total;


                    const row =
                        document.createElement("div");


                    row.className =
                        "cart-row";


                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between gap-2">

                            <div class="fw-semibold item-name"></div>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                class="btn btn-sm btn-link text-danger p-0 remove-item">

                                Remove

                            </button>

                        </div>

                        <div class="small text-muted mb-2">
                            ${item.price.toFixed(2)} JOD each
                        </div>

                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">

                            <div class="quantity-control">

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    class="decrease">

                                    −

                                </button>

                                <span>
                                    ${item.quantity}
                                </span>

                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    class="increase">

                                    +

                                </button>

                            </div>

                            <strong>
                                ${total.toFixed(2)} JOD
                            </strong>

                        </div>

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="Items[${index}].ProductId"
                            value="${item.id}" />

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="Items[${index}].Quantity"
                            value="${item.quantity}" />

                        <input
                            type="hidden"
                            name="Items[${index}].SalePrice"
                            value="${item.price}" />
                    `;


                    row
                        .querySelector(".item-name")
                        .textContent =
                        item.name;


                    row
                        .querySelector(".increase")
                        .addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            () => changeQuantity(item.id, 1)
                        );


                    row
                        .querySelector(".decrease")
                        .addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            () => changeQuantity(item.id, -1)
                        );


                    row
                        .querySelector(".remove-item")
                        .addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            () => {

                                cart.delete(item.id);

                                renderCart();

                            }
                        );


                    cartItems.appendChild(row);

                }
            );


            document
                .getElementById("cartCount")
                .textContent =
                `${totalQuantity} item${
                    totalQuantity === 1
                        ? ""
                        : "s"
                }`;


            document
                .getElementById("itemCount")
                .textContent =
                totalQuantity;


            document
                .getElementById("grandTotal")
                .textContent =
                grandTotal.toFixed(2);

        }


        // Initial state.
        updateProductAvailability();

    </script>
}}
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
@model MiniStore.Application.Dtos.Settings.DiscountSettingsDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Discount Settings";

<div class="container-fluid">

    ```
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <div>

        <div class="card mb-4">

            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="form-check form-switch">

                           class="form-check-input"
                           type="checkbox" />

                    <label asp-for="Enabled" class="form-check-label">

                    </label>

        <!-- Where discounts can be applied -->
        <div class="card mb-4">

            </div>

            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="form-check mb-3">

                           class="form-check-input"
                           type="checkbox" />

                    <label asp-for="AllowLineDiscount"
                           class="form-check-label">
                        Allow Line Discount
                    </label>

                    <div class="form-text">
                        Allow discount to be applied to individual sale items.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="form-check">
                    <input asp-for="AllowInvoiceDiscount"
                           class="form-check-input"
                           type="checkbox" />

                           class="form-check-label">

                    </label>

        <!-- Discount Types -->
        <div class="card mb-4">
            <div class="card-header">
                <h5 class="mb-0">Discount Types</h5>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="form-check mb-3">
                    <input asp-for="AllowPercentageDiscount"
                           class="form-check-input"
                           type="checkbox" />

                    <label asp-for="AllowPercentageDiscount"
                           class="form-check-label">
                        Percentage Discount
                    </label>
                </div>

                <div class="form-check mb-4">
                    <input asp-for="AllowFixedAmountDiscount"
                           class="form-check-input"
                           type="checkbox" />

                    <label asp-for="AllowFixedAmountDiscount"
                           class="form-check-label">
                        Fixed Amount Discount
                    </label>
                </div>

                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label asp-for="DefaultDiscountType"
                           class="form-label">
                        Default Discount Type
                    </label>

                    <select asp-for="DefaultDiscountType"
                            class="form-select">

                        <option value="1">Percentage</option>
                        <option value="2">Fixed Amount</option>

                    </select>

                    <div class="form-text">
                        This type will be selected by default when creating a discount.
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Line Discount Limits -->
        <div class="card mb-4">
            <div class="card-header">
                <h5 class="mb-0">Line Discount Limits</h5>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="row">

                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label asp-for="MaxLineDiscountPercent"
                               class="form-label">
                            Maximum Line Discount %
                        </label>

                        <input asp-for="MaxLineDiscountPercent"
                               class="form-control"
                               type="number"
                               min="0"
                               max="100"
                               step="0.01" />
                    </div>

                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label asp-for="MaxLineDiscountAmount"
                               class="form-label">
                            Maximum Line Discount Amount
                        </label>

                        <input asp-for="MaxLineDiscountAmount"
                               class="form-control"
                               type="number"
                               min="0"
                               step="0.01" />
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Invoice Discount Limits -->
        <div class="card mb-4">
            <div class="card-header">
                <h5 class="mb-0">Invoice Discount Limits</h5>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="row">

                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label asp-for="MaxInvoiceDiscountPercent"
                               class="form-label">
                            Maximum Invoice Discount %
                        </label>

                        <input asp-for="MaxInvoiceDiscountPercent"
                               class="form-control"
                               type="number"
                               min="0"
                               max="100"
                               step="0.01" />
                    </div>

                    <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                        <label asp-for="MaxInvoiceDiscountAmount"
                               class="form-label">
                            Maximum Invoice Discount Amount
                        </label>

                        <input asp-for="MaxInvoiceDiscountAmount"
                               class="form-control"
                               type="number"
                               min="0"
                               step="0.01" />
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Override -->
        <div class="card mb-4">
            <div class="card-header">
                <h5 class="mb-0">Discount Override</h5>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="form-check mb-3">
                    <input asp-for="AllowDiscountAboveLimit"
                           class="form-check-input"
                           type="checkbox" />

                    <label asp-for="AllowDiscountAboveLimit"
                           class="form-check-label">
                        Allow Discount Above Limit
                    </label>

                    <div class="form-text">
                        Users with the configured permission can exceed the normal discount limits.
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="mb-3">
                    <label asp-for="DiscountOverridePermission"
                           class="form-label">
                        Override Permission
                    </label>

                    <input asp-for="DiscountOverridePermission"
                           class="form-control" />

                    <div class="form-text">
                        Permission required to exceed the configured discount limits.
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Actions -->
        <div class="d-flex gap-2 mb-5">

            <button type="submit"
                    class="btn btn-primary">
                Save
            </button>

            <a asp-controller="Settings"
               asp-action="Index"
               class="btn btn-secondary">
                Cancel
            </a>

        </div>

    </form>
    ```

</div>
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
    ViewData["Title"] = "Invoice Settings";
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
<div class="modal fade"
     id="deleteModal"
     tabindex="-1"
     aria-hidden="true">

    <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">

        <div class="modal-content">

            <div class="modal-header">

                <h5 class="modal-title">
                    Confirm Delete
                </h5>

                <button type="button"
                        class="btn-close"
                        data-bs-dismiss="modal">
                </button>

            </div>

            <div class="modal-body">

                <p>
                    Are you sure you want to delete
                    <strong id="deleteItemName"></strong>?
                </p>

                <p class="text-danger mb-0">
                    This action cannot be undone.
                </p>

            </div>

            <div class="modal-footer">

                <button type="button"
                        class="btn btn-secondary"
                        data-bs-dismiss="modal">
                    Cancel
                </button>

                <form id="deleteForm"
                      method="post">

                    @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                    <input type="hidden"
                           id="deleteItemId"
                           name="id" />

                    <button type="submit"
                            class="btn btn-danger">
                        Delete
                    </button>

                </form>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

<script>

    function confirmDelete(id, name, deleteUrl) {

        document.getElementById("deleteItemId").value = id;

        document.getElementById("deleteItemName").textContent = name;

        document.getElementById("deleteForm").action = deleteUrl;

            var modalElement =
            document.getElementById("deleteModal");

            var modal =
            new bootstrap.Modal(modalElement);

            modal.show();
        }

</script>
~~~~

## File: `MiniStore.Web\Views\Shared\_Layout.cshtml`

~~~~cshtml
```cshtml
<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

    <meta charset="utf-8" />

    <meta name="viewport"
          content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />

    <title>
        @ViewData["Title"] - MiniStore
    </title>

    <link rel="stylesheet"
          href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" />

    <link rel="stylesheet"
          href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css" />

    <style>

            body {
                background-color: #f8f9fa;
            }

            .navbar {
                box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            }

            .navbar-brand {
                font-weight: 700;
                letter-spacing: 0.3px;
            }

            .navbar-nav .nav-link {
                font-weight: 500;
                padding-left: 0.8rem;
                padding-right: 0.8rem;
            }

                .navbar-nav .nav-link:hover {
                    color: #ffffff;
                }

            .dropdown-menu {
                border: 0;
                border-radius: 10px;
                box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
                padding: 0.5rem;
                min-width: 220px;
            }

            .dropdown-item {
                border-radius: 7px;
                padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem;
                font-weight: 500;
            }

                .dropdown-item:hover {
                    background-color: #f1f3f5;
                }

                .dropdown-item.active {
                    font-weight: 600;
                }

                .dropdown-item i {
                    width: 22px;
                    margin-right: 6px;
                }

            .user-menu {
                border-left: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
                padding-left: 1rem;
            }

            .user-name {
                color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
                font-weight: 500;
            }

    </style>

</head>

<body>

    <nav class="navbar navbar-expand-lg navbar-dark bg-dark">

        <div class="container">

            <!-- Brand -->
            <a class="navbar-brand"
               asp-controller="Home"
               asp-action="Index">

                <i class="bi bi-shop"></i>
                MiniStore

            </a>


            <!-- Mobile Toggle -->
            <button class="navbar-toggler"
                    type="button"
                    data-bs-toggle="collapse"
                    data-bs-target="#mainNavbar"
                    aria-controls="mainNavbar"
                    aria-expanded="false"
                    aria-label="Toggle navigation">

                <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>

            </button>


            <div class="collapse navbar-collapse"
                 id="mainNavbar">

                @{
                    var currentUserId =
                        User.FindFirstValue(
                            ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);

                    var navigationGroups =
                        NavigationDefinitions.All
                            .OrderBy(x => x.Order)
                            .ToList();

                    var currentController =
                        ViewContext.RouteData.Values["controller"]
                            ?.ToString();

                    var currentAction =
                        ViewContext.RouteData.Values["action"]
                            ?.ToString();
                }


                <ul class="navbar-nav me-auto mb-2 mb-lg-0">

                    @foreach (var group in navigationGroups)
                    {
                        var visibleItems =
                            new List<NavigationItem>();

                        foreach (var item in group.Items)
                        {
                            if (await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                    currentUserId ?? "System",
                                    item.Permission))
                            {
                                visibleItems.Add(item);
                            }
                        }

                        if (visibleItems.Count == 0)
                        {
                            continue;
                        }


                        <li class="nav-item dropdown">

                            <a class="nav-link dropdown-toggle"
                               href="#"
                               role="button"
                               data-bs-toggle="dropdown"
                               aria-expanded="false">

                                <i class="bi @group.Icon"></i>
                                @group.Title

                            </a>


                            <ul class="dropdown-menu">

                                @foreach (var item in visibleItems)
                                {
                                    var isActive =
                                        string.Equals(
                                            currentController,
                                            item.Controller,
                                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                                        &&
                                        string.Equals(
                                            currentAction,
                                            item.Action,
                                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

                                    <li>

                                        <a class="dropdown-item @(isActive ? "active" : "")"
                                           asp-controller="@item.Controller"
                                           asp-action="@item.Action">

                                            <i class="bi @item.Icon"></i>
                                            @item.Title

                                        </a>

                                    </li>
                                }

                            </ul>

                        </li>
                    }

                </ul>


                <!-- Current User -->
                @if (User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
                {
                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center user-menu">

                        <span class="user-name me-3">

                            <i class="bi bi-person-circle"></i>
                            @User.Identity.Name

                        </span>


                        <form asp-controller="Account"
                              asp-action="Logout"
                              method="post"
                              class="d-inline">

                            @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                            <button type="submit"
                                    class="btn btn-outline-light btn-sm">

                                <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-right"></i>
                                Logout

                            </button>

                        </form>

                    </div>
                }

            </div>

        </div>

    </nav>


    <main class="container mt-4">

        @await Html.PartialAsync("_Notification")

        @await Html.PartialAsync("_ConfirmDelete")

        @RenderBody()

    </main>


    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js">
    </script>

    @await RenderSectionAsync(
        "Scripts",
        required: false)

</body>

</html>
```
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
@if (TempData["NotificationMessage"] != null)
{
    var type = TempData["NotificationType"]?.ToString() ?? "info";

    var title = type switch
    {
        "success" => "Success",
        "error" => "Error",
        "warning" => "Warning",
        _ => "Information"
    };

    var alertClass = type switch
    {
        "success" => "alert-success",
        "error" => "alert-danger",
        "warning" => "alert-warning",
        _ => "alert-info"
    };

    <div class="modal fade"
         id="notificationModal"
         tabindex="-1"
         aria-hidden="true">

        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">

            <div class="modal-content">

                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title">
                        @title
                    </h5>

                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn-close"
                            data-bs-dismiss="modal">
                    </button>
                </div>

                <div class="modal-body">

                    <div class="alert @alertClass mb-0">
                        @TempData["NotificationMessage"]
                    </div>

                </div>

                <div class="modal-footer">

                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn btn-secondary"
                            data-bs-dismiss="modal">
                        Close
                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {

            const modalElement =
                document.getElementById("notificationModal");

            const modal =
                new bootstrap.Modal(modalElement);

            modal.show();

        });
    </script>
}
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
@model MiniStore.Application.DTOs.ProductStocks.CreateStockTransactionDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Create Stock Transaction";
}

<h1>Create Stock Transaction</h1>

<form asp-action="Create" method="post">

    <div class="mb-3">

        <label asp-for="ProductId"
               class="form-label">
            Product
        </label>

        <select asp-for="ProductId"
                class="form-select">

            <option value="">
                -- Select Product --
            </option>

            @foreach (var product in ViewBag.Products)
            {
                <option value="@product.Id">
                    @product.Name
                </option>
            }

        </select>

        <span asp-validation-for="ProductId"
              class="text-danger">
        </span>

    </div>

    <div class="mb-3">

        <label asp-for="WarehouseId"
               class="form-label">
            Warehouse
        </label>

        <select asp-for="WarehouseId"
                class="form-select">

            <option value="">
                -- Select Warehouse --
            </option>

            @foreach (var warehouse in ViewBag.Warehouses)
            {
                <option value="@warehouse.Id">
                    @warehouse.Name
                </option>
            }

        </select>

        <span asp-validation-for="WarehouseId"
              class="text-danger">
        </span>

    </div>

    <div class="mb-3">

        <label asp-for="Type"
               class="form-label">
            Transaction Type
        </label>

        <select asp-for="Type"
                class="form-select">

            <option value="">
                -- Select Type --
            </option>

            <option value="1">
                Opening Balance
            </option>

            <option value="2">
                Purchase
            </option>

            <option value="3">
                Sale
            </option>

            <option value="4">
                Transfer In
            </option>

            <option value="5">
                Transfer Out
            </option>

            <option value="6">
                Adjustment In
            </option>

            <option value="7">
                Adjustment Out
            </option>

        </select>

        <span asp-validation-for="Type"
              class="text-danger">
        </span>

    </div>

    <div class="mb-3">

        <label asp-for="Quantity"
               class="form-label">
            Quantity
        </label>

        <input asp-for="Quantity"
               type="number"
               step="0.001"
               class="form-control"
               placeholder="Example: 10" />

        <div class="form-text">
            Enter the quantity as a positive number.
            The transaction type determines whether stock
            increases or decreases.
        </div>

        <span asp-validation-for="Quantity"
              class="text-danger">
        </span>

    </div>

    <div class="mb-3">

        <label asp-for="Reference"
               class="form-label">
            Reference
        </label>

        <input asp-for="Reference"
               class="form-control"
               placeholder="Example: INV-001" />

        <span asp-validation-for="Reference"
              class="text-danger">
        </span>

    </div>

    <button type="submit"
            class="btn btn-success">
        Save
    </button>

    <a asp-action="Index"
       class="btn btn-secondary">
        Cancel
    </a>

</form>
~~~~
