## File: `MiniStore.Web\Views\StockTransactions\Index.cshtml`

~~~~cshtml
@using MiniStore.Domain.Entities
@model MiniStore.Application.DTOs.ProductStocks.StockTransactionPagedResultDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Stock Transactions";

    var search = ViewBag.Search as string;
    var selectedType = ViewBag.Type as StockTransactionType?;
    var movement = ViewBag.Movement as string;
    var fromDate = ViewBag.FromDate as DateTime?;
    var toDate = ViewBag.ToDate as DateTime?;
    var sortColumn = ViewBag.SortColumn as string ?? "date";
    var sortDescending = ViewBag.SortDescending is bool b && b;

    var startRecord =
        Model.TotalCount == 0
            ? 0
            : ((Model.Page - 1) * Model.PageSize) + 1;

    var endRecord =
        Math.Min(
            Model.Page * Model.PageSize,
            Model.TotalCount);

    string SortUrl(string column)
    {
        var newDescending =
            sortColumn.Equals(
                column,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? !sortDescending
                : false;

        return Url.Action(
            "Index",
            new
            {
                search,
                type = selectedType,
                movement,
                fromDate =
                    fromDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                toDate =
                    toDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                page = 1,
                pageSize = Model.PageSize,
                sortColumn = column,
                sortDescending = newDescending
            })!;
    }

    string SortIcon(string column)
    {
        if (!sortColumn.Equals(
                column,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return "";
        }

        return sortDescending
            ? "▼"
            : "▲";
    }

    string PageUrl(int page)
    {
        return Url.Action(
            "Index",
            new
            {
                search,
                type = selectedType,
                movement,
                fromDate =
                    fromDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                toDate =
                    toDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                page,
                pageSize = Model.PageSize,
                sortColumn,
                sortDescending
            })!;
    }
}

<div class="container-fluid">

    <!-- Page Header -->
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">

        <div>
            <h2 class="mb-1">
                <i class="bi bi-clock-history"></i>
                Stock Transactions
            </h2>

            <p class="text-muted mb-0">
                View and analyze stock movement history.
            </p>
        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Filters -->
    <div class="card shadow-sm mb-4">

        <div class="card-header">
            <strong>
                <i class="bi bi-funnel"></i>
                Search & Filters
            </strong>
        </div>

        <div class="card-body">

            <form method="get"
                  asp-action="Index">

                <div class="row g-3">

                    <!-- Search -->
                    <div class="col-md-4">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Search
                        </label>

                        <input type="text"
                               name="search"
                               value="@search"
                               class="form-control"
                               placeholder="Product, warehouse, reference..." />

                    </div>


                    <!-- Transaction Type -->
                    <div class="col-md-2">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Transaction Type
                        </label>

                        <select name="type"
                                class="form-select">

                            @if (!selectedType.HasValue)
                            {
                                <option value="" selected>
                                    All Types
                                </option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="">
                                    All Types
                                </option>
                            }

                            @foreach (var transactionType
                                in Enum.GetValues<StockTransactionType>())
                            {
                                if (selectedType == transactionType)
                                {
                                    <option value="@transactionType"
                                            selected>
                                        @transactionType
                                    </option>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <option value="@transactionType">
                                        @transactionType
                                    </option>
                                }
                            }

                        </select>

                    </div>


                    <!-- Movement -->
                    <div class="col-md-2">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Movement
                        </label>

                        <select name="movement"
                                class="form-select">

                            @if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(movement))
                            {
                                <option value="" selected>
                                    All
                                </option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="">
                                    All
                                </option>
                            }

                            @if (movement == "incoming")
                            {
                                <option value="incoming" selected>
                                    Incoming
                                </option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="incoming">
                                    Incoming
                                </option>
                            }

                            @if (movement == "outgoing")
                            {
                                <option value="outgoing" selected>
                                    Outgoing
                                </option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="outgoing">
                                    Outgoing
                                </option>
                            }

                        </select>

                    </div>


                    <!-- From Date -->
                    <div class="col-md-2">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            From Date
                        </label>

                        <input type="date"
                               name="fromDate"
                               value="@fromDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")"
                               class="form-control" />

                    </div>


                    <!-- To Date -->
                    <div class="col-md-2">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            To Date
                        </label>

                        <input type="date"
                               name="toDate"
                               value="@toDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")"
                               class="form-control" />

                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="row g-3 mt-1">

                    <!-- Page Size -->
                    <div class="col-md-2">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Rows per page
                        </label>

                        <select name="pageSize"
                                class="form-select">

                            @foreach (var size in new[] { 25, 50, 100, 250 })
                            {
                                if (Model.PageSize == size)
                                {
                                    <option value="@size"
                                            selected>
                                        @size
                                    </option>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <option value="@size">
                                        @size
                                    </option>
                                }
                            }

                        </select>

                    </div>


                    <!-- Buttons -->
                    <div class="col-md-10 d-flex align-items-end gap-2">

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-primary">

                            <i class="bi bi-search"></i>
                            Search

                        </button>


                        <a asp-action="Index"
                           class="btn btn-outline-secondary">

                            <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i>
                            Clear Filters

                        </a>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <!-- Keep sorting when submitting filters -->
                <input type="hidden"
                       name="sortColumn"
                       value="@sortColumn" />

                <input type="hidden"
                       name="sortDescending"
                       value="@sortDescending" />

                <!-- Always start from page 1 after filtering -->
                <input type="hidden"
                       name="page"
                       value="1" />

            </form>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Summary -->
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">

        <div class="text-muted">

            @if (Model.TotalCount > 0)
            {
                <span>
                    Showing
                    <strong>@startRecord</strong>
                    -
                    <strong>@endRecord</strong>
                    of
                    <strong>@Model.TotalCount</strong>
                    transactions
                </span>
            }
            else
            {
                <span>
                    No transactions found.
                </span>
            }

        </div>


        @if (Model.TotalPages > 0)
        {
            <div class="text-muted">

                Page
                <strong>@Model.Page</strong>
                of
                <strong>@Model.TotalPages</strong>

            </div>
        }

    </div>


    <!-- Transactions Table -->
    <div class="card shadow-sm">

        <div class="card-body p-0">

            <div class="table-responsive">

                <table class="table table-hover table-striped mb-0">

                    <thead class="table-dark">

                        <tr>

                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("id")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Id

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "id",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("id")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("product")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Product

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "product",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("product")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("warehouse")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Warehouse

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "warehouse",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("warehouse")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("quantity")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Quantity

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "quantity",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("quantity")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("type")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Type

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "type",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("type")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("reference")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Reference

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "reference",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("reference")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                <a href="@SortUrl("date")"
                                   class="text-white text-decoration-none">

                                    Date

                                    @if (sortColumn.Equals(
                                        "date",
                                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                                    {
                                        <span class="ms-1">
                                            @SortIcon("date")
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </a>
                            </th>

                        </tr>

                    </thead>


                    <tbody>

                        @if (Model.Items.Any())
                        {
                            foreach (var transaction in Model.Items)
                            {
                                <tr>

                                    <!-- Id -->
                                    <td>
                                        @transaction.Id
                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Product -->
                                    <td>

                                        <strong>
                                            @transaction.ProductName
                                        </strong>

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Warehouse -->
                                    <td>
                                        @transaction.WarehouseName
                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Quantity -->
                                    <td>

                                        @if (transaction.Quantity > 0)
                                        {
                                            <span class="text-success fw-bold">
                                                +@transaction.Quantity
                                            </span>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <span class="text-danger fw-bold">
                                                @transaction.Quantity
                                            </span>
                                        }

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Type -->
                                    <td>

                                        @switch (transaction.Type)
                                        {
                                            case StockTransactionType.Purchase:

                                                <span class="badge bg-success">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            case StockTransactionType.OpeningBalance:

                                                <span class="badge bg-info text-dark">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            case StockTransactionType.TransferIn:

                                                <span class="badge bg-primary">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            case StockTransactionType.AdjustmentIn:

                                                <span class="badge bg-success">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            case StockTransactionType.Sale:

                                                <span class="badge bg-danger">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            case StockTransactionType.TransferOut:

                                                <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            case StockTransactionType.AdjustmentOut:

                                                <span class="badge bg-danger">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;

                                            default:

                                                <span class="badge bg-secondary">
                                                    @transaction.Type
                                                </span>

                                                break;
                                        }

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Reference -->
                                    <td>

                                        @if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                                            transaction.Reference))
                                        {
                                            <span class="text-muted">
                                                -
                                            </span>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            @transaction.Reference
                                        }

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Date -->
                                   
                                        <td>
                                            @transaction.CreatedAt.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss")
                                        </td>


                                </tr>
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <tr>

                                <td colspan="7"
                                    class="text-center py-5">

                                    <div class="text-muted">

                                        <i class="bi bi-inbox fs-1 d-block mb-2"></i>

                                        <h5>
                                            No transactions found
                                        </h5>

                                        <p class="mb-0">
                                            Try changing your search or filters.
                                        </p>

                                    </div>

                                </td>

                            </tr>
                        }

                    </tbody>

                </table>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Pagination -->
    @if (Model.TotalPages > 1)
    {
        <div class="d-flex justify-content-center mt-4">

            <nav aria-label="Stock transaction pagination">

                <ul class="pagination">

                    <!-- Previous -->
                    @if (Model.Page > 1)
                    {
                        <li class="page-item">

                            <a class="page-link"
                               href="@PageUrl(Model.Page - 1)">

                                <i class="bi bi-chevron-left"></i>
                                Previous

                            </a>

                        </li>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <li class="page-item disabled">

                            <span class="page-link">

                                <i class="bi bi-chevron-left"></i>
                                Previous

                            </span>

                        </li>
                    }


                    @{
                        var startPage =
                            Math.Max(
                                1,
                                Model.Page - 2);

                        var endPage =
                            Math.Min(
                                Model.TotalPages,
                                Model.Page + 2);
                    }


                    <!-- First page -->
                    @if (startPage > 1)
                    {
                        <li class="page-item">

                            <a class="page-link"
                               href="@PageUrl(1)">
                                1
                            </a>

                        </li>

                        @if (startPage > 2)
                        {
                            <li class="page-item disabled">

                                <span class="page-link">
                                    ...
                                </span>

                            </li>
                        }
                    }


                    <!-- Page numbers -->
                    @for (
                        var pageNumber = startPage;
                        pageNumber <= endPage;
                        pageNumber++)
                    {
                        if (pageNumber == Model.Page)
                        {
                            <li class="page-item active">

                                <span class="page-link">
                                    @pageNumber
                                </span>

                            </li>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <li class="page-item">

                                <a class="page-link"
                                   href="@PageUrl(pageNumber)">
                                    @pageNumber
                                </a>

                            </li>
                        }
                    }


                    <!-- Last page -->
                    @if (endPage < Model.TotalPages)
                    {
                        @if (endPage < Model.TotalPages - 1)
                        {
                            <li class="page-item disabled">

                                <span class="page-link">
                                    ...
                                </span>

                            </li>
                        }

                        <li class="page-item">

                            <a class="page-link"
                               href="@PageUrl(Model.TotalPages)">

                                @Model.TotalPages

                            </a>

                        </li>
                    }


                    <!-- Next -->
                    @if (Model.Page < Model.TotalPages)
                    {
                        <li class="page-item">

                            <a class="page-link"
                               href="@PageUrl(Model.Page + 1)">

                                Next
                                <i class="bi bi-chevron-right"></i>

                            </a>

                        </li>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <li class="page-item disabled">

                            <span class="page-link">

                                Next
                                <i class="bi bi-chevron-right"></i>

                            </span>

                        </li>
                    }

                </ul>

            </nav>

        </div>
    }

</div>
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
@using MiniStore.Application.DTOs.StockTransfers
@using MiniStore.Domain.Entities

@model CreateStockTransferDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "New Stock Transfer";

    var products =
        ViewBag.Products as List<Product>
        ?? new List<Product>();

    var warehouses =
        ViewBag.Warehouses as List<Warehouse>
        ?? new List<Warehouse>();
}


<div class="container-fluid">

    <!-- Page Header -->

    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">

        <div>

            <h2 class="mb-1">
                New Stock Transfer
            </h2>

            <p class="text-muted mb-0">
                Transfer multiple products between warehouses.
            </p>

        </div>

        <div>

            <a asp-action="Index"
               class="btn btn-outline-secondary">

                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>

                Back

            </a>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- Form -->

    <form asp-action="Create"
          method="post"
          id="stockTransferForm">

        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()


        <!-- Transfer Information -->

        <div class="card shadow-sm mb-4">

            <div class="card-header bg-white">

                <strong>
                    Transfer Information
                </strong>

            </div>


            <div class="card-body">

                <div class="row g-3">


                    <!-- From Warehouse -->

                    <div class="col-md-6">

                        <label asp-for="FromWarehouseId"
                               class="form-label">

                            From Warehouse

                        </label>


                        <select asp-for="FromWarehouseId"
                                class="form-select"
                                id="fromWarehouse">

                            <option value="">
                                -- Select source warehouse --
                            </option>


                            @foreach (var warehouse in warehouses)
                            {
                                <option value="@warehouse.Id">

                                    @warehouse.Name

                                </option>
                            }

                        </select>


                        <span asp-validation-for="FromWarehouseId"
                              class="text-danger">
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <!-- To Warehouse -->

                    <div class="col-md-6">

                        <label asp-for="ToWarehouseId"
                               class="form-label">

                            To Warehouse

                        </label>


                        <select asp-for="ToWarehouseId"
                                class="form-select"
                                id="toWarehouse">

                            <option value="">
                                -- Select destination warehouse --
                            </option>


                            @foreach (var warehouse in warehouses)
                            {
                                <option value="@warehouse.Id">

                                    @warehouse.Name

                                </option>
                            }

                        </select>


                        <span asp-validation-for="ToWarehouseId"
                              class="text-danger">
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <!-- Reference -->

                    <div class="col-md-6">

                        <label asp-for="Reference"
                               class="form-label">

                            Reference

                        </label>


                        <input asp-for="Reference"
                               class="form-control"
                               maxlength="200"
                               placeholder="Optional reference..." />


                        <span asp-validation-for="Reference"
                              class="text-danger">
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <!-- Notes -->

                    <div class="col-md-6">

                        <label asp-for="Notes"
                               class="form-label">

                            Notes

                        </label>


                        <input asp-for="Notes"
                               class="form-control"
                               maxlength="1000"
                               placeholder="Optional notes..." />


                        <span asp-validation-for="Notes"
                              class="text-danger">
                        </span>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>


        <!-- Transfer Items -->

        <div class="card shadow-sm mb-4">

            <div class="card-header bg-white">

                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">

                    <strong>
                        Transfer Items
                    </strong>


                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn btn-sm btn-primary"
                            id="addItemButton">

                        <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i>

                        Add Product

                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>


            <div class="card-body p-0">

                <div class="table-responsive">

                    <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">

                        <thead class="table-light">

                            <tr>

                                <th style="width: 50%;">
                                    Product
                                </th>

                                <th style="width: 25%;">
                                    Quantity
                                </th>

                                <th style="width: 15%;">
                                    Barcode
                                </th>

                                <th style="width: 10%;"
                                    class="text-end">

                                    Action

                                </th>

                            </tr>

                        </thead>


                        <tbody id="itemsTableBody">
                        </tbody>

                    </table>

                </div>


                <div id="emptyItemsMessage"
                     class="text-center py-5">

                    <i class="bi bi-box-seam display-5 text-muted"></i>


                    <h6 class="mt-3">

                        No products added

                    </h6>


                    <p class="text-muted mb-0">

                        Add at least one product to create the transfer.

                    </p>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>


        <!-- Product Template -->

        <select id="productTemplate"
                class="d-none">

            <option value="">
                -- Select product --
            </option>


            @foreach (var product in products)
            {
                <option value="@product.Id"
                        data-barcode="@product.Barcode">

                    @product.Name

                </option>
            }

        </select>


        <!-- Validation Summary -->

        <div asp-validation-summary="ModelOnly"
             class="text-danger mb-3">
        </div>


        <!-- Actions -->

        <div class="d-flex justify-content-end gap-2">

            <a asp-action="Index"
               class="btn btn-outline-secondary">

                Cancel

            </a>


            <button type="submit"
                    class="btn btn-primary">

                <i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i>

                Create Transfer

            </button>

        </div>

    </form>

</div>


@section Scripts
{

    <partial name="_ValidationScriptsPartial" />


    <script>

        let itemIndex = 0;


        // ================================================
        // Elements
        // ================================================

        const itemsTableBody =
            document.getElementById("itemsTableBody");

        const emptyItemsMessage =
            document.getElementById("emptyItemsMessage");

        const productTemplate =
            document.getElementById("productTemplate");

        const addItemButton =
            document.getElementById("addItemButton");

        const stockTransferForm =
            document.getElementById("stockTransferForm");

        const fromWarehouse =
            document.getElementById("fromWarehouse");

        const toWarehouse =
            document.getElementById("toWarehouse");


        // ================================================
        // Empty State
        // ================================================

        function updateEmptyState() {
            if (itemsTableBody.children.length === 0) {
                emptyItemsMessage.style.display = "block";
            }
            else {
                emptyItemsMessage.style.display = "none";
            }
        }


        // ================================================
        // Selected Products
        // ================================================

        function getSelectedProductIds() {
            const selects =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".product-select"
                );


            return Array.from(selects)
                .map(select => parseInt(select.value))
                .filter(id => !isNaN(id));
        }


        // ================================================
        // Refresh Product Options
        // ================================================

        function refreshProductOptions() {
            const selectedIds =
                getSelectedProductIds();


            document
                .querySelectorAll(".product-select")
                .forEach(select => {
                    const currentValue =
                        parseInt(select.value);


                    const currentOptions =
                        productTemplate.options;


                    select.innerHTML = "";


                    Array.from(currentOptions)
                        .forEach(templateOption => {
                            const productId =
                                parseInt(
                                    templateOption.value
                                );


                            if (
                                productId &&
                                selectedIds.includes(productId) &&
                                productId !== currentValue
                            ) {
                                return;
                            }


                            const option =
                                templateOption.cloneNode(true);


                            if (
                                productId === currentValue
                            ) {
                                option.selected = true;
                            }


                            select.appendChild(option);

                        });

                });


            updateBarcodes();
        }


        // ================================================
        // Update Barcode
        // ================================================

        function updateBarcodes() {
            document
                .querySelectorAll(".product-select")
                .forEach(select => {
                    const row =
                        select.closest("tr");


                    const barcodeCell =
                        row.querySelector(
                            ".barcode-cell"
                        );


                    const selectedOption =
                        select.options[
                        select.selectedIndex
                        ];


                    if (
                        selectedOption &&
                        selectedOption.value
                    ) {
                        barcodeCell.textContent =
                            selectedOption.dataset.barcode
                            || "—";
                    }
                    else {
                        barcodeCell.textContent =
                            "—";
                    }

                });
        }


        // ================================================
        // Add Item
        // ================================================

        function addItem() {
            const row =
                document.createElement("tr");


            row.innerHTML = `
                        <td>

                            <select
                                name="Items[${itemIndex}].ProductId"
                                class="form-select product-select"
                                required>
                            </select>

                        </td>


                        <td>

                            <input
                                type="number"
                                name="Items[${itemIndex}].Quantity"
                                class="form-control quantity-input"
                                min="0.001"
                                step="0.001"
                                required
                                placeholder="0.000" />

                        </td>


                        <td class="barcode-cell text-muted">

                            —

                        </td>


                        <td class="text-end">

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger remove-item">

                                <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>

                            </button>

                        </td>
                    `;


            itemsTableBody.appendChild(row);


            const select =
                row.querySelector(
                    ".product-select"
                );


            // Copy product options

            Array.from(productTemplate.options)
                .forEach(templateOption => {
                    const option =
                        templateOption.cloneNode(true);

                    select.appendChild(option);
                });


            // Product changed

            select.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function() {
                    refreshProductOptions();
                }
            );


            // Remove item

            const removeButton =
                row.querySelector(
                    ".remove-item"
                );


            removeButton.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function() {
                    row.remove();

                    refreshProductOptions();

                    updateEmptyState();
                }
            );


            itemIndex++;


            updateEmptyState();

            refreshProductOptions();
        }


        // ================================================
        // Add Product
        // ================================================

        addItemButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function() {
                addItem();
            }
        );


        // ================================================
        // Form Validation
        // ================================================

        stockTransferForm.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function(event) {

                // ----------------------------------------
                // Warehouse validation
                // ----------------------------------------

                if (
                    fromWarehouse.value &&
                    toWarehouse.value &&
                    fromWarehouse.value === toWarehouse.value
                ) {
                    event.preventDefault();


                    alert(
                        "Source and destination warehouses must be different."
                    );


                    return;
                }


                // ----------------------------------------
                // Items validation
                // ----------------------------------------

                const rows =
                    document.querySelectorAll(
                        "#itemsTableBody tr"
                    );


                if (rows.length === 0) {
                    event.preventDefault();


                    alert(
                        "Add at least one product."
                    );


                    return;
                }


                // ----------------------------------------
                // Product validation
                // ----------------------------------------

                const selectedIds =
                    getSelectedProductIds();


                const hasMissingProduct =
                    selectedIds.length !== rows.length;


                if (hasMissingProduct) {
                    event.preventDefault();


                    alert(
                        "Please select a product for every row."
                    );


                    return;
                }


                // ----------------------------------------
                // Duplicate validation
                // ----------------------------------------

                const hasDuplicate =
                    selectedIds.some(
                        (id, index) =>
                            selectedIds.indexOf(id) !== index
                    );


                if (hasDuplicate) {
                    event.preventDefault();


                    alert(
                        "The same product cannot be added more than once."
                    );


                    return;
                }


                // ----------------------------------------
                // Quantity validation
                // ----------------------------------------

                let invalidQuantity = false;


                document
                    .querySelectorAll(".quantity-input")
                    .forEach(input => {
                        const quantity =
                            parseFloat(
                                input.value
                            );


                        if (
                            isNaN(quantity) ||
                            quantity <= 0
                        ) {
                            invalidQuantity = true;
                        }

                    });


                if (invalidQuantity) {
                    event.preventDefault();


                    alert(
                        "All quantities must be greater than zero."
                    );


                    return;
                }

            }
        );


        // ================================================
        // Initial State
        // ================================================

        updateEmptyState();

    </script>

}
~~~~

~~~~cshtml
@using MiniStore.Application.DTOs.StockTransfers
@using MiniStore.Domain.Entities
@using System.Security.Claims

@model StockTransferDetailsDto

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = $"Stock Transfer - {Model.TransferNumber}";

    var userId =
        User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) ?? "";
}


<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">

    <div>

        <h2>
            Stock Transfer
        </h2>

        <div class="text-muted">
            @Model.TransferNumber
        </div>

    </div>


    <div>

        <a asp-action="Index"
           class="btn btn-secondary">

            <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            Back to List

        </a>

    </div>

</div>


<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- Status -->
<!-- ========================================== -->

<div class="card mb-4">

    <div class="card-body">

        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">

            <div>

                <strong>
                    Status:
                </strong>


                @switch (Model.Status)
                {
                    case StockTransferStatus.Draft:

                        <span class="badge bg-secondary">
                            Draft
                        </span>

                        break;


                    case StockTransferStatus.Submitted:

                        <span class="badge bg-primary">
                            Submitted
                        </span>

                        break;


                    case StockTransferStatus.Approved:

                        <span class="badge bg-success">
                            Approved
                        </span>

                        break;


                    case StockTransferStatus.Rejected:

                        <span class="badge bg-danger">
                            Rejected
                        </span>

                        break;


                    case StockTransferStatus.Posted:

                        <span class="badge bg-dark">
                            Posted
                        </span>

                        break;


                    case StockTransferStatus.Cancelled:

                        <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">
                            Cancelled
                        </span>

                        break;
                }

            </div>


            <!-- ========================================== -->
            <!-- Workflow Actions -->
            <!-- ========================================== -->

            <div class="d-flex gap-2">


                <!-- Edit -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Draft &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Edit"))
                {
                    <a asp-action="Edit"
                       asp-route-id="@Model.Id"
                       class="btn btn-outline-primary">

                        <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
                        Edit

                    </a>
                }


                <!-- Submit -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Draft &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Submit"))
                {
                    <form asp-action="Submit"
                          method="post"
                          class="d-inline">

                        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                        <input type="hidden"
                               name="id"
                               value="@Model.Id" />

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-primary">

                            Submit

                        </button>

                    </form>
                }


                <!-- Approve -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Submitted &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Approve"))
                {
                    <form asp-action="Approve"
                          method="post"
                          class="d-inline">

                        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                        <input type="hidden"
                               name="id"
                               value="@Model.Id" />

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-success">

                            Approve

                        </button>

                    </form>
                }


                <!-- Reject -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Submitted &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Reject"))
                {
                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn btn-danger"
                            data-bs-toggle="modal"
                            data-bs-target="#rejectModal">

                        Reject

                    </button>
                }


                <!-- Return To Draft -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Rejected &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Edit"))
                {
                    <form asp-action="ReturnToDraft"
                          method="post"
                          class="d-inline">

                        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                        <input type="hidden"
                               name="id"
                               value="@Model.Id" />

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-warning">

                            Return to Draft

                        </button>

                    </form>
                }


                <!-- Post -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Approved &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Post"))
                {
                    <form asp-action="Post"
                          method="post"
                          class="d-inline">

                        @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                        <input type="hidden"
                               name="id"
                               value="@Model.Id" />

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-success">

                            Post

                        </button>

                    </form>
                }


                <!-- Cancel -->
                @if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Posted &&
                                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                         userId,
                                         "StockTransfers.Cancel"))
                {
                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn btn-danger"
                            data-bs-toggle="modal"
                            data-bs-target="#cancelModal">

                        Cancel

                    </button>
                }

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>


<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- Transfer Information -->
<!-- ========================================== -->

<div class="card mb-4">

    <div class="card-header">

        <h5 class="mb-0">
            Transfer Information
        </h5>

    </div>


    <div class="card-body">

        <div class="row">


            <!-- Transfer Number -->

            <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">

                <strong>
                    Transfer Number
                </strong>

                <div>

</div>


<!-- ========================================== -->

@if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Rejected)

<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- Items -->

<div class="card mb-4">

    <div class="card-header">

        <h5 class="mb-0">
            Transfer Items
        </h5>

    </div>


    <div class="card-body p-0">

        @if (Model.Items.Any())
        {
            <div class="table-responsive">

                <table class="table table-bordered table-hover mb-0">

                    <thead class="table-light">

                        <tr>

                            <th style="width: 70px;">
                                #
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                Product
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                Barcode
                            </th>

                            <th class="text-end">
                                Quantity
                            </th>

                        </tr>

                    </thead>


                    <tbody>

                        @{
                            var itemNumber = 1;
                        }


                        @foreach (var item in Model.Items)
                        {
                            <tr>

                                <td>
                                    @itemNumber
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    @item.ProductName
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    @(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Barcode)
                                        ? "-"
                                        : item.Barcode)
                                </td>

                                <td class="text-end">
                                    @item.Quantity.ToString("N3")
                                </td>

                            </tr>

                            itemNumber++;
                        }

                    </tbody>


                    <tfoot class="table-light">

                        <tr>

                            <th colspan="3"
                                class="text-end">

                                Total Quantity

                            </th>

                            <th class="text-end">

                                @(Model.Items
                                    .Sum(x => x.Quantity)
                                    .ToString("N3"))

                            </th>

                        </tr>

                    </tfoot>

                </table>

            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="p-4 text-muted">

                No items found.

            </div>
        }

    </div>

</div>


<!-- ========================================== -->

<div class="card mb-4">

    <div class="card-header">

        <h5 class="mb-0">

        </h5>

    </div>


    <div class="card-body">

        <div class="row">

            <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">

                    @(Model.SubmittedAt?
                        .ToLocalTime()
                        .ToString()
                        ?? "-")

                </small>

            </div>


            <!-- Approved -->

            <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">

                <strong>
                    Approved By
                </strong>

                <div>

                    @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.ApprovedByUserName))
                    {
                        @Model.ApprovedByUserName
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <span class="text-muted">
                            -
                        </span>
                    }

                </div>

                <small class="text-muted">

                    @(Model.ApprovedAt?
                        .ToLocalTime()
                        .ToString()

                    }

                    }

                <small class="text-muted">

                    @(Model.CancelledAt?

                        .ToString()
                        ?? "-")

                </small>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>


<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- Workflow History -->
<!-- ========================================== -->

<div class="card mb-4">

    <div class="card-header">

        <h5 class="mb-0">
            Workflow History
        </h5>

    </div>


    <div class="card-body p-0">

        @if (Model.History.Any())
        {
            <div class="table-responsive">

                <table class="table table-bordered table-hover mb-0">

                    <thead class="table-light">

                        <tr>

                            <th>
                                Date
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                Action
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                From
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                To
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                User
                            </th>

                            <th>
                                Reason
                            </th>

                        </tr>

                    </thead>


                    <tbody>

                        @foreach (
                            var history in
                            Model.History.OrderBy(
                                x => x.CreatedAt))
                        {
                            <tr>

                                <td>
                                    @history.CreatedAt.ToLocalTime()
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    @history.Action
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    @history.FromStatus
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    @history.ToStatus
                                </td>

                                <td>

                                    @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(history.UserName))
                                    {
                                        @history.UserName
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <span class="text-muted">
                                            Unknown User
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </td>

                                <td>

                                    @(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                                        history.Reason)
                                        ? "-"
                                        : history.Reason)

                                </td>

                            </tr>
                        }

                    </tbody>

                </table>

            </div>
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="p-4 text-muted">

                No workflow history found.

            </div>
        }

    </div>

</div>

<!-- Reject Modal -->

@if (Model.Status == StockTransferStatus.Submitted &&
     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
         userId,
         "StockTransfers.Reject"))
{
    <div class="modal fade"
         id="rejectModal"
         tabindex="-1"
         aria-hidden="true">

        <div class="modal-dialog">

            <div class="modal-content">

                <form asp-action="Reject"
                      method="post">

                                data-bs-dismiss="modal">
                        </button>

                               value="@Model.Id" />


                        <div class="mb-3">

                                   class="form-label">

                            </label>

                            <textarea id="rejectionReason"
                                      name="reason"
                                      class="form-control"
                                      rows="4"
                                      required></textarea>

                        </div>

                    </div>


                    <div class="modal-footer">

                        <button type="button"
                                class="btn btn-secondary"
                                data-bs-dismiss="modal">

                            Close

                        </button>


                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-danger">

                            Reject

                        </button>

                    </div>

                </form>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>
}
~~~~
