@using MiniStore.Application.DTOs.StockTransfers

@model UpdateStockTransferDto

@{
    var transferId =
        Context.Request.RouteValues["id"]?.ToString()
        ?? string.Empty;

    ViewData["Title"] =
        $"Edit Stock Transfer - {ViewBag.TransferNumber}";
}

<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">

    <div>
        <h2>
            Edit Stock Transfer
        </h2>

        <div class="text-muted">
            @ViewBag.TransferNumber
        </div>
    </div>

    <div>

        <a asp-action="Details"
           asp-route-id="@transferId"
           class="btn btn-secondary">

            <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            Back to Details

        </a>

    </div>

</div>


<form asp-action="Edit"
      asp-route-id="@transferId"
      method="post"
      id="editTransferForm">

    @Html.AntiForgeryToken()


    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Transfer Information -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="card mb-4">

        <div class="card-header">

            <h5 class="mb-0">
                Transfer Information
            </h5>

        </div>

        <div class="card-body">

            <div class="row">

                <!-- From Warehouse -->

                <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        From Warehouse
                    </label>

                    <select asp-for="FromWarehouseId"
                            class="form-select"
                            id="fromWarehouse"
                            required>

                        <option value="">
                            -- Select Source Warehouse --
                        </option>

                        @foreach (var warehouse in ViewBag.Warehouses)
                        {
                            <option value="@warehouse.Id">
                                @warehouse.Name
                            </option>
                        }

                    </select>

                    <span asp-validation-for="FromWarehouseId"
                          class="text-danger">
                    </span>

                </div>


                <!-- To Warehouse -->

                <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">

                    <label class="form-label">
                        To Warehouse
                    </label>

                    <select asp-for="ToWarehouseId"
                            class="form-select"
                            id="toWarehouse"
                            required>

                        <option value="">
                            -- Select Destination Warehouse --
                        </option>

                        @foreach (var warehouse in ViewBag.Warehouses)
                        {
                            <option value="@warehouse.Id">
                                @warehouse.Name
                            </option>
                        }

                    </select>

                    <span asp-validation-for="ToWarehouseId"
                          class="text-danger">
                    </span>

                </div>


                <!-- Reference -->

                <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">

                    <label asp-for="Reference"
                           class="form-label">

                        Reference

                    </label>

                    <input asp-for="Reference"
                           class="form-control"
                           maxlength="200" />

                    <span asp-validation-for="Reference"
                          class="text-danger">
                    </span>

                </div>


                <!-- Notes -->

                <div class="col-12 mb-3">

                    <label asp-for="Notes"
                           class="form-label">

                        Notes

                    </label>

                    <textarea asp-for="Notes"
                              class="form-control"
                              rows="3"
                              maxlength="1000"></textarea>

                    <span asp-validation-for="Notes"
                          class="text-danger">
                    </span>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Items -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="card mb-4">

        <div class="card-header d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">

            <h5 class="mb-0">
                Transfer Items
            </h5>

            <button type="button"
                    class="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
                    id="addItemButton">

                <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i>
                Add Product

            </button>

        </div>


        <div class="card-body">

            <!-- Product template -->

            <select id="productTemplate"
                    class="d-none">

                <option value="">
                    -- Select Product --
                </option>

                @foreach (var product in ViewBag.Products)
                {
                    <option value="@product.Id"
                            data-barcode="@product.Barcode">

                        @product.Name

                    </option>
                }

            </select>


            <!-- Items -->

            <div id="itemsContainer">

                @for (var i = 0; i < Model.Items.Count; i++)
                {
                    <div class="item-row border rounded p-3 mb-3">

                        <div class="row align-items-end">

                            <!-- Product -->

                            <div class="col-md-5 mb-2">

                                <label class="form-label">
                                    Product
                                </label>

                                <select name="Items[@i].ProductId"
                                        class="form-select product-select"
                                        required>

                                    <option value="">
                                        -- Select Product --
                                    </option>

                                    @foreach (var product in ViewBag.Products)
                                    {
                                        if (product.Id ==
                                            Model.Items[i].ProductId)
                                        {
                                            <option value="@product.Id"
                                                    data-barcode="@product.Barcode"
                                                    selected>

                                                @product.Name

                                            </option>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <option value="@product.Id"
                                                    data-barcode="@product.Barcode">

                                                @product.Name

                                            </option>
                                        }
                                    }

                                </select>

                            </div>


                            <!-- Barcode -->

                            <div class="col-md-3 mb-2">

                                <label class="form-label">
                                    Barcode
                                </label>

                                <input type="text"
                                       class="form-control barcode-display"
                                       readonly />

                            </div>


                            <!-- Quantity -->

                            <div class="col-md-2 mb-2">

                                <label class="form-label">
                                    Quantity
                                </label>

                                <input type="number"
                                       name="Items[@i].Quantity"
                                       class="form-control quantity-input"
                                       value="@Model.Items[i].Quantity"
                                       min="0.001"
                                       step="0.001"
                                       required />

                            </div>


                            <!-- Remove -->

                            <div class="col-md-2 mb-2">

                                <button type="button"
                                        class="btn btn-outline-danger w-100 remove-item-button">

                                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                                    Remove

                                </button>

                            </div>

                        </div>

                    </div>
                }

            </div>


            <!-- Empty state -->

            <div id="emptyItemsMessage"
                 class="alert alert-secondary"
                 style="@(Model.Items.Any()
                                     ? "display:none;"
                                     : "")">

                No products have been added yet.

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Information -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="alert alert-info">

        <i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i>

        <strong>Draft Transfer:</strong>

        Editing this transfer does not change stock.
        Stock movement occurs only after the transfer
        is approved and posted.

    </div>


    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Actions -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="d-flex justify-content-end gap-2 mb-5">

        <a asp-action="Details"
           asp-route-id="@transferId"
           class="btn btn-secondary">

            Cancel

        </a>

        <button type="submit"
                class="btn btn-primary">

            <i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i>
            Save Changes

        </button>

    </div>

</form>


@section Scripts
{
    @await Html.PartialAsync(
        "_ValidationScriptsPartial")


    <script>

        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function() {

                const itemsContainer =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "itemsContainer");

                const addItemButton =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "addItemButton");

                const productTemplate =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "productTemplate");

                const emptyItemsMessage =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "emptyItemsMessage");

                const form =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "editTransferForm");


                // ==========================================
                // Update Empty State
                // ==========================================

                function updateEmptyState() {

                    const rows =
                        itemsContainer.querySelectorAll(
                            ".item-row");

                    emptyItemsMessage.style.display =
                        rows.length === 0
                            ? ""
                            : "none";
                }


                // ==========================================
                // Reindex Items
                // ==========================================

                function reindexItems() {

                    const rows =
                        itemsContainer.querySelectorAll(
                            ".item-row");

                    rows.forEach(
                        function(row, index) {

                            const productSelect =
                                row.querySelector(
                                    ".product-select");

                            const quantityInput =
                                row.querySelector(
                                    ".quantity-input");


                            if (productSelect) {

                                productSelect.name =
                                    "Items[" +
                                    index +
                                    "].ProductId";
                            }


                            if (quantityInput) {

                                quantityInput.name =
                                    "Items[" +
                                    index +
                                    "].Quantity";
                            }

                        });
                }


                // ==========================================
                // Update Barcode
                // ==========================================

                function updateBarcode(row) {

                    if (!row) {
                        return;
                    }

                    const select =
                        row.querySelector(
                            ".product-select");

                    const barcodeInput =
                        row.querySelector(
                            ".barcode-display");


                    if (!select ||
                        !barcodeInput) {

                        return;
                    }


                    const selectedOption =
                        select.options[
                        select.selectedIndex];


                    if (!selectedOption ||
                        !selectedOption.value) {

                        barcodeInput.value =
                            "";

                        return;
                    }


                    barcodeInput.value =
                        selectedOption.dataset.barcode
                        || "";
                }


                // ==========================================
                // Check Duplicate Products
                // ==========================================

                function hasDuplicateProducts() {

                    const selects =
                        itemsContainer.querySelectorAll(
                            ".product-select");

                    const selectedIds =
                        new Set();


                    for (const select of selects) {

                        const productId =
                            select.value;


                        if (!productId) {
                            continue;
                        }


                        if (selectedIds.has(
                            productId)) {

                            return true;
                        }


                        selectedIds.add(
                            productId);
                    }


                    return false;
                }


                // ==========================================
                // Add Item
                // ==========================================

                function addItem() {

                    const row =
                        document.createElement(
                            "div");

                    row.className =
                        "item-row border rounded p-3 mb-3";


                    row.innerHTML =
                        '<div class="row align-items-end">' +

                        '<div class="col-md-5 mb-2">' +

                        '<label class="form-label">' +
                        'Product' +
                        '</label>' +

                        '<select class="form-select product-select" required>' +

                        productTemplate.innerHTML +

                        '</select>' +

                        '</div>' +


                        '<div class="col-md-3 mb-2">' +

                        '<label class="form-label">' +
                        'Barcode' +
                        '</label>' +

                        '<input type="text" ' +
                        'class="form-control barcode-display" ' +
                        'readonly />' +

                        '</div>' +


                        '<div class="col-md-2 mb-2">' +

                        '<label class="form-label">' +
                        'Quantity' +
                        '</label>' +

                        '<input type="number" ' +
                        'class="form-control quantity-input" ' +
                        'min="0.001" ' +
                        'step="0.001" ' +
                        'required />' +

                        '</div>' +


                        '<div class="col-md-2 mb-2">' +

                        '<button type="button" ' +
                        'class="btn btn-outline-danger w-100 remove-item-button">' +

                        '<i class="bi bi-trash"></i> ' +
                        'Remove' +

                        '</button>' +

                        '</div>' +

                        '</div>';


                    itemsContainer.appendChild(
                        row);


                    reindexItems();

                    updateEmptyState();

                    updateBarcode(row);
                }


                // ==========================================
                // Remove Item
                // ==========================================

                function removeItem(button) {

                    const row =
                        button.closest(
                            ".item-row");


                    if (!row) {
                        return;
                    }


                    row.remove();


                    reindexItems();

                    updateEmptyState();
                }


                // ==========================================
                // Add Button
                // ==========================================

                addItemButton.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function() {

                        addItem();

                    });


                // ==========================================
                // Product Change
                // ==========================================

                itemsContainer.addEventListener(
                    "change",
                    function(event) {

                        if (
                            event.target.classList.contains(
                                "product-select")
                        ) {

                            const row =
                                event.target.closest(
                                    ".item-row");

                            updateBarcode(row);
                        }

                    });


                // ==========================================
                // Remove Button
                // ==========================================

                itemsContainer.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function(event) {

                        const button =
                            event.target.closest(
                                ".remove-item-button");


                        if (!button) {
                            return;
                        }


                        removeItem(button);

                    });


                // ==========================================
                // Initial Barcode Values
                // ==========================================

                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        ".item-row")
                    .forEach(
                        function(row) {

                            updateBarcode(row);

                        });


                // ==========================================
                // Form Validation
                // ==========================================

                form.addEventListener(
                    "submit",
                    function(event) {

                        const fromWarehouse =
                            document.getElementById(
                                "fromWarehouse").value;

                        const toWarehouse =
                            document.getElementById(
                                "toWarehouse").value;


                        // Same warehouse

                        if (
                            fromWarehouse &&
                            toWarehouse &&
                            fromWarehouse ===
                            toWarehouse
                        ) {

                            event.preventDefault();

                            alert(
                                "Source and destination warehouses must be different.");

                            return;
                        }


                        // No items

                        const rows =
                            itemsContainer.querySelectorAll(
                                ".item-row");


                        if (rows.length === 0) {

                            event.preventDefault();

                            alert(
                                "A transfer must contain at least one product.");

                            return;
                        }


                        // Duplicate products

                        if (hasDuplicateProducts()) {

                            event.preventDefault();

                            alert(
                                "The same product cannot be added more than once.");

                            return;
                        }


                        // Quantity validation

                        let invalidQuantity =
                            false;


                        rows.forEach(
                            function(row) {

                                const quantityInput =
                                    row.querySelector(
                                        ".quantity-input");


                                const quantity =
                                    parseFloat(
                                        quantityInput.value);


                                if (
                                    !quantity ||
                                    quantity <= 0
                                ) {

                                    invalidQuantity =
                                        true;
                                }

                            });


                        if (invalidQuantity) {

                            event.preventDefault();

                            alert(
                                "All quantities must be greater than zero.");

                            return;
                        }


                        // Make sure indexes are consecutive
                        // before submitting.

                        reindexItems();

                    });


                // ==========================================
                // Initial State
                // ==========================================

                updateEmptyState();

                reindexItems();

            });

    </script>
}

@using MiniStore.Domain.Entities
@using MiniStore.Application.DTOs.StockTransfers

@model List<StockTransferDto>

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Stock Transfers";

    var selectedStatus =
        ViewBag.Status as StockTransferStatus?;

    var search =
        ViewBag.Search as string;

    var userId =
        User.FindFirstValue(
            ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
}


<div class="container-fluid">

    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Header -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">

        <div>

            <h2 class="mb-1">
                Stock Transfers
            </h2>

            <p class="text-muted mb-0">
                Manage warehouse-to-warehouse stock transfers.
            </p>

        </div>


        <!-- New Transfer -->
        @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userId) &&
                     await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                         userId,
                         "StockTransfers.Create"))
        {
            <a asp-action="Create"
               class="btn btn-primary">

                <i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i>
                New Transfer

            </a>
        }

    </div>


    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Filters -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="card shadow-sm mb-4">

        <div class="card-body">

            <form asp-action="Index"
                  method="get">

                <div class="row g-3 align-items-end">


                    <!-- Search -->

                    <div class="col-md-6">

                        <label for="search"
                               class="form-label">

                            Search

                        </label>

                        <input type="text"
                               id="search"
                               name="search"
                               value="@search"
                               class="form-control"
                               placeholder="Transfer number or reference..." />

                    </div>


                    <!-- Status -->

                    <div class="col-md-4">

                        <label for="status"
                               class="form-label">

                            Status

                        </label>

                        <select id="status"
                                name="status"
                                class="form-select">

                            <option value="">
                                All statuses
                            </option>


                            @foreach (var status in
                                Enum.GetValues<StockTransferStatus>())
                            {
                                if (selectedStatus == status)
                                {
                                    <option value="@status"
                                            selected>

                                        @status

                                    </option>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <option value="@status">

                                        @status

                                    </option>
                                }
                            }

                        </select>

                    </div>


                    <!-- Search / Reset -->

                    <div class="col-md-2 d-flex gap-2">

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-primary flex-grow-1">

                            <i class="bi bi-search"></i>
                            Search

                        </button>


                        <a asp-action="Index"
                           class="btn btn-outline-secondary">

                            <i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i>

                        </a>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </form>

        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- ========================================== -->
    <!-- Transfers Table -->
    <!-- ========================================== -->

    <div class="card shadow-sm">

        <div class="card-header bg-white">

            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">

                <strong>
                    Stock Transfers
                </strong>

                <span class="text-muted">
                    @Model.Count transfer(s)
                </span>

            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="card-body p-0">

            @if (Model == null || !Model.Any())
            {
                <div class="text-center py-5">

                    <i class="bi bi-box-seam display-4 text-muted"></i>

                    <h5 class="mt-3">
                        No stock transfers found
                    </h5>

                    <p class="text-muted mb-0">
                        There are no transfers matching the current filters.
                    </p>

                </div>
            }
            else
            {
                <div class="table-responsive">

                    <table class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">

                        <thead class="table-light">

                            <tr>

                                <th>
                                    Transfer #
                                </th>

                                <th>
                                    From Warehouse
                                </th>

                                <th>
                                    To Warehouse
                                </th>

                                <th class="text-center">
                                    Items
                                </th>

                                <th>
                                    Status
                                </th>

                                <th>
                                    Created At
                                </th>

                                <th>
                                    Reference
                                </th>

                                <th class="text-end">
                                    Actions
                                </th>

                            </tr>

                        </thead>


                        <tbody>

                            @foreach (var transfer in Model)
                            {
                                <tr>


                                    <!-- Transfer Number -->

                                    <td>

                                        <strong>
                                            @transfer.TransferNumber
                                        </strong>

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- From -->

                                    <td>
                                        @transfer.FromWarehouseName
                                    </td>


                                    <!-- To -->

                                    <td>
                                        @transfer.ToWarehouseName
                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Items -->

                                    <td class="text-center">
                                        @transfer.ItemsCount
                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Status -->

                                    <td>

                                        @switch (transfer.Status)
                                        {
                                            case StockTransferStatus.Draft:

                                                <span class="badge bg-secondary">
                                                    Draft
                                                </span>

                                                break;


                                            case StockTransferStatus.Submitted:

                                                <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">
                                                    Submitted
                                                </span>

                                                break;


                                            case StockTransferStatus.Approved:

                                                <span class="badge bg-info text-dark">
                                                    Approved
                                                </span>

                                                break;


                                            case StockTransferStatus.Rejected:

                                                <span class="badge bg-danger">
                                                    Rejected
                                                </span>

                                                break;


                                            case StockTransferStatus.Posted:

                                                <span class="badge bg-success">
                                                    Posted
                                                </span>

                                                break;


                                            case StockTransferStatus.Cancelled:

                                                <span class="badge bg-dark">
                                                    Cancelled
                                                </span>

                                                break;
                                        }

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Created At -->

                                    <td>
                                        @(transfer.CreatedAt.ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"))
                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Reference -->

                                    <td>

                                        @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                                            transfer.Reference))
                                        {
                                            @transfer.Reference
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <span class="text-muted">
                                                —
                                            </span>
                                        }

                                    </td>


                                    <!-- Actions -->

                                    <td class="text-end">

                                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-end gap-1">


                                            <!-- Details -->

                                            <a asp-action="Details"
                                               asp-route-id="@transfer.Id"
                                               class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">

                                                <i class="bi bi-eye"></i>
                                                Details

                                            </a>


                                            <!-- Edit -->
                                            @if (
                                                                                            transfer.Status ==
                                                                                            StockTransferStatus.Draft
                                                                                            &&
                                                                                            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                                                                                                userId)
                                                                                            &&
                                                                                            await PermissionService.CanAsync(
                                                                                                userId,
                                                                                                "StockTransfers.Edit"))
                                            {
                                                <a asp-action="Edit"
                                                   asp-route-id="@transfer.Id"
                                                   class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">

                                                    <i class="bi bi-pencil"></i>
                                                    Edit

                                                </a>
                                            }

                                        </div>

                                    </td>

                                </tr>
                            }

                        </tbody>

                    </table>

                </div>
            }

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

~~~~

</table>

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Create User";

    var roles =
        ViewBag.Roles
        as List<IdentityRole>;
}

<div class="row justify-content-center">

    <div class="col-md-6">

        <div class="card">

            <div class="card-header">
                <h4 class="mb-0">
                    Create User
                </h4>
            </div>

            <div class="card-body">

                @if (ViewBag.Error != null)
                {
                    <div class="alert alert-danger">
                        @ViewBag.Error
                    </div>
                }

                <form asp-action="Create"
                      method="post">

                    @Html.AntiForgeryToken()

                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Username
                        </label>

                        <input type="text"
                               name="username"
                               class="form-control"
                               required />

                    </div>

                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Email
                        </label>

                        <input type="email"
                               name="email"
                               class="form-control"
                               required />

                    </div>

                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Password
                        </label>

                        <input type="password"
                               name="password"
                               class="form-control"
                               required />

                    </div>

                    <div class="mb-3">

                        <label class="form-label">
                            Role
                        </label>

                        <select name="role"
                                class="form-select"
                                required>

                            <option value="">
                                -- Select Role --
                            </option>

                            @if (roles != null)
                            {
                                foreach (var role in roles)
                                {
                                    <option value="@role.Name">
                                        @role.Name
                                    </option>
                                }
                            }

                        </select>

                    </div>

                    <div class="d-flex gap-2">

                        <button type="submit"
                                class="btn btn-primary">
                            Create User
                        </button>

                        <a asp-action="Index"
                           class="btn btn-secondary">
                            Cancel
                        </a>

                    </div>

                </form>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

~~~~cshtml
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@model List<IdentityUser>

@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Users";
    var userRoles =
        ViewBag.UserRoles
        as Dictionary<string, IList<string>>;
}

<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
    <h2>Users</h2>

    <a asp-action="Create"
       class="btn btn-primary">
        + Add User
    </a>
</div>

@if (TempData["Success"] != null)
{
    <div class="alert alert-success">
        @TempData["Success"]
    </div>
}

<div class="card">
    <div class="card-body">

        <table class="table table-hover">

            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>Username</th>
                    <th>Email</th>
                    <th>Role</th>
                    <th>Email Confirmed</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody>

                @foreach (var user in Model)
                {
                    <tr>

                        <td>
                            @user.UserName
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            @user.Email
                        </td>

                        <td>

                            @if (userRoles != null &&
                                userRoles.ContainsKey(user.Id))
                            {
                                var roles =
                                    userRoles[user.Id];

                                if (roles.Any())
                                {
                                    @string.Join(", ", roles)
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <span class="text-muted">
                                        No Role
                                    </span>
                                }
                            }

                        </td>

                        <td>

                            @if (user.EmailConfirmed)
                            {
                                <span class="badge bg-success">
                                    Yes
                                </span>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <span class="badge bg-secondary">
                                    No
                                </span>
                            }

                        </td>

                    </tr>
                }

            </tbody>

        </table>

    </div>
</div>
~~~~
